items.title: Spotify’s is giving you the keys to its recommendation algorithm with US launch of ‘Taste Profile’
items.summary: Spotify is rolling out Taste Profile to Premium users in the U.S., letting listeners see how the streamer understands their tastes and use natural language to reshape their recommendations.

items.title: LinkedIn adds new tools to fight fake profiles and bogus work histories
items.summary: LinkedIn is rolling out new verification tools that let members vouch for colleagues’ work experience and give companies more control over accounts that falsely claim to employ them.

items.title: PitPro’s first tire-changing robot goes live in Canada
items.summary: The startup says its automated system can change four tires in under 15 minutes.

items.title: Comma’s hands-off driving tech under investigation after 2 fatal crashes
items.summary: The investigation involves at least some crashes where it appears drivers were using "forked" versions of Comma's software.

items.title: Ema raises $77M as AI starts eating into enterprise software and services
items.summary: Ema has raised $140 million to date and has more than 50 enterprise customers, including Google and Microsoft.

items.title: ‘We’re already fighting yesterday’s battle’: Greece’s prime minister gets candid about AI
items.summary: Most leaders on a trade mission stick to the pitch, but when I interviewed Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis this week, he also admitted that no government is ready for what AI is about to do.

items.title: Discord’s age-verification era is upon us, despite community backlash
items.summary: According to Discord, 90% of users will not have to verify their age.

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit’s agenda revealed: Unlock fundraising, hiring, and AI insights in Boston on November 4
items.summary: Founders shouldn't have to learn the hardest lessons the hardest way. TechCrunch Founder Summit is designed to make the challenges of starting a company easier and the highs that much greater.

items.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms
items.summary: The seven-year-old startup has raised a $350 million Series E to fuel its data-as-a-service approach.

items.title: Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI

items.title: Apple could take on Whoop with a new fitness tracker, report says
items.summary: Apple may be developing a new fitness tracker as part of its new generation of hardware devices.

items.title: Meta admits Muse’s likeness to OpenClaw isn’t a coincidence
items.summary: Meta says Muse was built from scratch, but acknowledges the AI assistant was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw — down to some of its workspace filenames and content.

items.title: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents’ and applicants’ data
items.summary: The theft of agents' personal information could present a major counterintelligence threat, where agents and their families are extorted into cooperating with a foreign government.

items.title: a16z is challenging Silicon Valley’s love for drop-outs by launching a school
items.summary: This academy for promising high school grads is somewhere between a trade school, Y Combinator, and Peter Thiel's Fellowship Program.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes

items.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance
items.summary: Anthropic called it "the strongest-performing model we've tested to date."

items.summary: Researchers say another looming threat hangs over some of America's most important critical infrastructure.

items.title: Noble Carbon will show how it’s making EV charger installs painless at TechCrunch Disrupt
